decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display builds directly on the firm's core cardboard display know-how, so in-house R&D can keep refining it, although its absence from the website in 2020 and 2021 adds some uncertainty.
The standard quarter-pallet shelf display is a core format that the firm fully understands and can produce efficiently, so it remains worth keeping despite its lower visibility online.
The eighth-pallet display extends a familiar format that the firm's existing expertise supports well, though the missing website presence since 2020 slightly raises the risk of withdrawal.

Wood lies outside the firm's paper-based knowledge base, which limits its ability to interpret results and improve the product, and its disappearance from the website suggests the resources are better redirected to core cardboard displays.
The media display rests on familiar cardboard know-how and can be adapted to other segments, but shrinking media demand and the missing website presence make it a riskier keep.
